carpet.rule.pigCannonUnstuck.desc: Fixes chunk loading behavior when player is a passenger of a very fast entity.
carpet.rule.lazyLinkingPre1_21Render.des: Returns the behavior of server sending packets with entity coordinates (MC-170907).
carpet.rule.lazyLinkingPre1_21Render.ext: This fixes lazy linking mob render with instant entity conveyor.
carpet.rule.blockUpdateSuppressionLagFix: Removes lag from creating crash reports from block update suppression.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerChunkLoadingPriori: Prioritizes loading chunks around Carpet mod fake player over real players.
!!!WARNING!!! This rule was written entirely by an AI, and the mod author does not know how it works.
It may cause the server to crash if used with world generation or optimization mods.
Bots get their own loading ticket throttler (4 chunks at a time per dimension, like vanilla), not shared with real players,
and their worldgen and light tasks run ahead of real players', nearest to the bot first.
Which chunks are loaded and at what level stays the same as in vanilla.
Fixes MC-311727 or 'Player standing on air - force-sending blocks below' message in server console
carpet.rule.instamineDeepslateWithNether: A player with a block breaking speed of 49 or higher (at least netherite pickaxe with efficiency 5 and haste 2 effect) can instamine deepslate.
carpet.rule.endGatewaysLoadChunks.desc: End gateways load chunks when an entity teleports through them.
carpet.rule.spawnParticlesWhenSpectatorG: Spawns a small cloud of white particles when a player switches their game mode to or from spectator mode.
carpet.rule.playerCommandNonOperatorSpaw: Specifies in which gamemodes non-operators can spawn players with /player command.
Determines what permission level allows editing other players' macros via /macro command.
carpet.rule.newTimeArgumentValues.desc: Adds new values for the time argument in commands such as /tick sprint.
carpet.rule.commandMacro.desc: Allows to create and execute a sequence of commands with a delay.
